---
name: Trial feedback
about: Tell us how the check worked on your repository, good or bad
labels: feedback
---

Thanks for trying Remit. Share only public information:
no credentials, private logs or private repository content.

### Repository

Public repository (or "private, not shared") and roughly how many workflow PRs
the check has seen.

### Useful findings

Findings that pointed at something worth a second look. Links to public PRs help.

### Noise

Findings that were wrong or not worth the attention, with the rule ID and,
if possible, a link or a minimal snippet.

### Missed changes

Workflow changes you expected it to flag but it didn't.

### Incomplete or error results

How often, and the diagnostic text from the job summary.

### Keep it?

Will you keep the check installed? Why or why not?
